[IRET.16.8] Node cross-references use the **`node_id`** field (a `uint32`
assigned per node), not array positions — e.g. a beta node names its
`left_parent_id` / `right_alpha_id`, a terminal its `parent_beta_id`. The
loader validates that every referenced `node_id` resolves before
constructing pointers; an unresolvable reference is
`DS_ERR_RETP_INDEX_OOB`.
